requires.n: Instant/Sorcery that Copies a Legendary Creature You Control without Bypassing Legend Rule

1704-4549-4836--227.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-4549-4836--227.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's second ability by tapping an untapped legendary creature you control, adding one mana.
Repeat until there are no more available creatures to tap.
Cast the first creature-copying spell, targeting Krark.
When you cast it, Krark and any additional copies of Krark trigger.
Resolve all Krark triggers, copying that spell for each flip you won, and returning that spell to your hand as long as you lost at least one flip.
Resolve each copy of that spell, creating a token copy of Krark each time.
If that spell is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the spell itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the spell into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 8 with the second creature-copying spell.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both spells end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-5921-5970-8296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2105-5778-7060-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2511-4082-4640--201.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Kemba triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

5220-5686-7729-7855--180.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Repeat
5220-5686-7729-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

5759-6777-7711.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Red Hulk.
5759-6777-7711.description:
Give Red Hulk and Screaming Nemesis indestructible using Unbreakable Formation.
Deal damage to Red Hulk.
Red Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis triggers, dealing damage to Red Hulk.
Repeat from step 3.
5759-6777-7711.notes: The final instance of damage can be flung at an opponent for infinite damage. If you can deal more damage to Red Hulk afterwards, you can deal infinite damage to more targets.

3240-5147-5631-6462.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

955-1368-1563-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
955-1368-1563-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2366-4974-5434-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4974-5434-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-7296.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2279-2438-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3991-4605-5231-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1385-4681-5170.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3101-3292-3480-3892.easyPrerequisites: You have an amount of {R} available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
3101-3292-3480-3892.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate it by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3101-3292-3480-3892.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

101-1018-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1018-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Skullwinder and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1018-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1308-2793-3743-5089-5436.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1308-2793-3743-5089-5436.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2793-3017-3743-4365-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3743-4365-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

751-4050-6073.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Angelic Sell-Sword trigger.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Sell-Sword trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1393-2364-4986-5231.manaNeeded: {1} if the permanent requires four or more mana to cast
1393-2364-4986-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast using {C}{C}{R}{R}.
1393-2364-4986-5231.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Cast the historic permanent from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Aether Channeler, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 3.
1393-2364-4986-5231.notes: If the historic permanent can be cast for less than {C}{C}{R}{R}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3054-4050-5465.notablePrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-5465.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1409-1633-1770-2039-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1633-1770-2039-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

852-2615-4629.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal and Tree of Perdition do not have summoning sickness.
Your life total is at lest two.
852-2615-4629.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing Tree of Perdition to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The opponent targeted in step 2 loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this during each of your turns if your life total allows.

2775-2919-3192-4050.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2775-2919-3192-4050.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

914-2438-3249.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2438-3249.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

15-643-1339-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-643-1339-5256.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the Insect's power.
Repeat from step 3.

687-2034-2405.notablePrerequisites: Three or more creatures have been put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
687-2034-2405.description:
Cast Caller of the Claw.
Caller of the Claw's trigger resolves creating at least 3 bear tokens with vigilance counters.
Sacrifice Caller of the Claw to Ashnod's Altar.
Pay {3} and remove three vigilance counters from among bear tokens you control to activate Tayam.
Sacrifice one bear token to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Mill 3 and return Caller of the Claw from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1630-2560.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1630-2560.notablePrerequisites: At least 7 creatures on the battlefield.
1630-2560.description:
Play Thromok, sacrificing the 7 creatures, giving him 49 +1/+1 counters.
Cast Chandra's Ignition targeting Thromok.
Deal 49 damage to each other creature and player.

3179-3263-3676-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}.
Oketra's Monument and Tangleroot triggers.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior token.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {1}.
Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
